Title: Availability Zones support for Service Fabric clusters

Body.Content: Availability Zones (AZ) is a high availability offering from Azure that protects applications and data from datacenter failures. By using AZ with Azure Service Fabric (ASF), customers will get higher reliability and resiliency for their applications running on Service Fabric clusters.
